initial.reason: Monomer1 is a small, synthesizable diepoxide containing an explicit oxirane substring 'C1OC1' and a second oxirane 'C2OC2' to provide two reactive epoxy sites for curing. The flexible ether-linked backbone (–COCCOCC–) moderates stiffness to help approach Tg ~80°C when cured with an amine hardener. Monomer2 is diethylenetriamine (NCCNCCN), a common, commercially available polyamine that contains multiple 'NC' sequences (amine-to-carbon linkages) and provides at least two nucleophilic N sites for ring-opening of the epoxides, yielding a highly crosslinked thermoset (raising Er toward ~50 MPa). The pair (epoxide vs. amine) is chemically compatible and practical for thermoset formation; epoxide multiplicity and tri-functional amine functionality balance crosslink density to approach the target Tg and elastic modulus.
